Creative Work Title

  • CURIE: gmeow:CreativeWorkTitle
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CreativeWorkTitle
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/documents

An appellation borne by a creative work — a document title, article headline, dataset name, or media title. Carries its own gmeow:nameLanguage and gmeow:nameScript so co-equal multilingual titles (e.g. 'The Matrix' / '黑客帝国') are separate first-class objects, never alternateName subordinates.

Structure

Subclass of: gmeow:Appellation

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:CreativeWorkTitle as a specialized kind of gmeow:Appellation. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Appellation
